# Date Field

Edit and validate a timezone-free calendar date as structured text.

## Examples

### Iso date

Edit a timezone-free civil date using an ISO-shaped value.

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Arrow Up</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Down</kbd> | Increment or decrement the active value segment. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | Commit the draft value. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Cancel the draft and restore the accepted value. |

## Accessibility

The labeled input preserves native text entry while announcing invalid, disabled, and readonly state.
